purpose: Thai requests that need NO external tool (notes, tickets, calendar, mailbox servers). Written before the Thai lexicon rule (research/THAI_TOOL_MENU_CRITERIA_R115.md section 2c). Adoption rule 3: on these, the mean number of external tools in the menu is at most 1. Several are deliberate near-misses that share a verb with an external tool (อ่าน, ดู, หา, เขียน, ลบ) but ask for a built-in tool or for no tool.
